svg.text: Every virtual machine, what it costs, and what it actually did. Verdicts come from 30 days of Azure Monitor telemetry — nothing here changes your estate.
Illustrative data — not a real account
Some recommendations have no price attached
2 machines could be resized, but the published price for the target size could not be read. They add nothing to the savings totals above.
Sorted worst-first: stopped machines, then idle, then oversized. Click a row for the evidence.
A machine with no usable CPU history names its own reason instead of being reported as idle. Read-only — nothing here is written back to Azure.
